name: Gradaly v2.1.1
title: Gradaly v2.1.1
notes:
### 🚀 Highlights & Improvements (v2.1.1)

- **Ultra-Lightweight 100% Vector PDF Grading Reports & Math**: Grading report pages (summary cover page, evaluation cards, rubrics, justifications, feedback, and LaTeX mathematical formulas) are now generated as native PDF vector text and vector Bézier curves instead of rasterized images across all PDF and Web export modes, reducing report page size by over 98% while delivering razor-sharp print and zoom quality.
- **Faster Web Portal Publishing & Instant Cancellation**: Reuses compressed scan pages for heavy multi-megabyte exam scans during Web Portal publishing, adds intra-copy cancellation with immediate HTTP abort when clicking "Cancel", and saves publishing progress incrementally.
- **Anthropic Model List Cleanup**: Removed retired Claude 3.5 Haiku, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and Claude Sonnet 4 fallback identifiers in favor of Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6, and Claude Haiku 4.5.
